Trans R Soc Trop Med Hyg 1994; 88: 95–7. Osteopetrosis. Interferon gamma has been tried in the treat- ment of malignant osteopetrosis (p.1509). A study1 in 14 patients found that interferon gamma-1b increased bone resorption. In 11 who received this treatment for 18 months there was stabilisation or improvement in clinical condition and a reduction in the fre- quency of serious infection. 1. Key LL, et al. Long-term treatment of osteopetrosis with recom- binant human interferon gamma. N Engl J Med 1995; 332: 1594–9. Skin disorders. Interferons have been tried in skin disorders in which IgE levels are raised.
